notes: Rewritten from the real official procedure document 'Phuong thuc khai thac hai duong CHC song song tai Cang HKQT Cam Ranh' (kem theo Quyet dinh so 81.../QD-CHK ngay 25/4/2022), at vietnam_ats_routes_pack/Du lieu PTB + code/QD duong CHC song song/CHC song song VVCR.pdf. The wake-turbulence AIRCRAFT_SEPARATION matrix is adopted from the identical national-standard matrix explicitly printed in the VVNB/VVTS procedure documents (see those rulesets' notes) since VVCR's own document only states separation is applied 'as if using a single runway' without reprinting the matrix.
